theme: Keeping an ensemble together over a rubato passage
title: Ensemble Cue Policy Through a Rubato
isolation: candidate runs as an isolated stdin->stdout subprocess via isorun; the hidden true phrase-tempo curve stays in the evaluator process
strategies: flat / never move: constant cue = 1.0 (reproduces the evaluator baseline -> ~0.1 everywhere)
uniform mean-of-all-players reactive tracking with simple smoothing (no role weighting, no latency anticipation): stable on the metronomic warm-ups, damped and late on rubato swells

role-weighted phrase estimate (trust the score's designated phrase-carrier channel instead of averaging in every player) + forward anticipation by the ensemble's mean reaction latency: tracks the swell and arrives on time across the whole family

per-beat latency-aware anticipation (shift by the CURRENT phrase-carrier's own latency rather than the ensemble mean) and role-weighted tightness shaping for the players who most need to land together at each moment
